what: On a horizontally overflowing strip, when the mouse moves into the left or right 30%, it auto-scrolls that way every frame by depth × .05 px (max 6px). It stops in the middle 40% and stops at once when the mouse leaves the strip. On phones and touch, you simply swipe with your finger.

options.zone: Ratio of reaction zones at both ends (0~.5), default .3
options.gain: Frame speed per px in the last cell, default .05

note: The original adds per 60Hz frame. Here it divides by the time between frames (16.7ms basis), so the speed is the same on 120Hz screens

from.where: index.html .hy-cats (pastel category card strip below the Hero — original .thumb_slider.scroll-container: 30% at both ends, ×.05, max 6px)
